The '''Multi-Altitude Assault Transport (MAAT)''' was an aerial vehicle that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Gunshipanddestroyertfu.png|thumb|left|200px|A MAAT deployed from its mothership.]]
The Multi Altitude Assault Transport was an evolution of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and was a rugged, combat ready [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] used by the Empire to deploy its [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in a variety of environments, as well as conditions. Its design was very similar to the LAAT except for the addition of two more wings above the primary wings, reminiscent of an [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]], and armor on the bubble-[[Cockpit/Legends|cockpits]].

Like its predecessor, the MAAT was armed with a variety of weapons which included [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. However, while the LAAT was primarily used to land troops on [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] surfaces, the MAAT instead was capable of transporting stormtroopers to much higher altitude locations such as upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] installations as well as [[Starship/Legends|starships]] hanging in low [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of a world.

A modified MAAT was even capable of flying short distances through [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in order to reach [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].

==History==
The MAAT was in service as early as [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] as one had crashed on a shore near [[Kento Marek]]'s home during the second major [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|crackdown on Kashyyyk]]. It was presumably used alongside it's [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/I]] predecessor to deploy [[Clone stormtrooper|Stormtroopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] during the engagement.

A gunship of this class was present during the [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|Battle]] of the [[TIE Fighter Construction Facility]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], where it attempted to send in [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] reinforcements against the facility's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] contingent. Before it could land, it was destroyed by [[Galen Marek]].

The Rebellion would use these, along with the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/is]], to transport troops across the battlefield in both space and planetary battles during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
